Synopsis:
    Fox News Media has parted ways with longtime business anchor Maria Bartiromo, effective immediately, after 12.5 years. No specific reason was given beyond a "business decision." Bartiromo hosted multiple shows on Fox Business and Fox News. Her departure comes amid broader White House staffing changes. She was previously implicated in Fox's Dominion defamation lawsuit, settled for $787.5M in 2023, with Smartmatic's case still pending.
